title: Microprocessor K.F. Moisture Titrator 2760

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="3275" img_size="medium" alignment="right" el_class="product_det_feat_img"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Microprocessor KF Moisture Titrator – 2760 is the finest volumetric titrator available. It uses the latest microcontroller technology and advanced engineering techniques so as to give enhanced accuracy and reproducibility. The system has user friendly prompts which guide you throughout the titration process. This titrator eliminates the use of conventional delicate and fragile glass burettes and plunger systems. It uses a highly sensitive motorized dispensing system for precise control of titrant volumes. This titrator analyses the moisture concentration of liquid samples, powder, fine particles and fiber samples that are soluble in alcohol or solvents. The moisture content is displayed in ppm, %age and mg H O.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

The system has 20 soft touch membrane type keys for ease of operation. Complete alphanumeric keypad is provided so as to feed the values of sample, density, titer factor, date, time etc. The End Point indication is given by both visual LED and audible alarm. The titrator has the facility for automatically calculating the titer factor of the Karl Fischer reagent. It uses the repeated averaging method so as to give the most accurate titer value. It can store 90 user defined setup files for ease of operation and final results of 300 titration . The internal battery backup provision has been made to store the results and the other titration parameters even if the instrument is switched OFF. Provision for external printer/PC attachment is available so that any of the stored results or the calibration and validation reports as per pharma compliance can be printed even at a later stage.
